host_baseline.basis: measured once with the pinned host and a role's structured-output tool (athena.toml [agents]); not measured per invocation

input.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

output.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_read.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_write.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cost.basis: Claude Code total_cost_usd, at list price

commands_run: cargo test -p athena-cli --test lifecycle closing_a_job_with_a_legacy 2>&1; cargo test -p athena-gate legacy_invocations 2>&1
cargo test -p athena-gate 2>&1; cargo fmt --check 2>&1; cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1; cargo test 2>&1
cargo test -p athena-gate --quiet 2>&1; cargo fmt --check 2>&1; cargo clippy --all-targets --locked --quiet -- -D warnings 2>&1; cargo test --quiet 2>&1

policy_denials.detail: git diff HEAD~1 --stat && cargo test -p athena-cli --test lifecycle closing_a_job_with_a_legacy 2>&1 | tail -5 && cargo test -p athena-gate legacy_invocations 2>&1 | tail -5
cargo test -p athena-cli --test lifecycle closing_a_job_with_a_legacy 2>&1 | grep -E "test |result"; cargo test -p athena-gate legacy_invocations 2>&1 | grep -E "test |result"

cargo test -p athena-gate 2>&1 | cargo fmt --check; cargo test -p athena-gate --quiet 2>&1; cargo fmt --check && echo FMT_OK; cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1; cargo test --locked --quiet 2>&1
